title: Giant Squid Ki Aankhein
idea: The giant squid has basketball-sized eyes, the largest of any living creature.

lines.text: Samundar ki gehraiyon mein chhupa hai ek aisa monster!
Kya aapko pata hai iski aankhein kitni badi hoti hain?
Giant squid ki aankhein kisi basketball jitni badi hoti hain!
Inka diameter kam se kam 27 centimeters tak hota hai.
Yeh kisi bhi zinda jeev ki sabse badi aankhein hain!
Kya aap itni badi aankh dekhna chahenge? Comment karo!
